sourceProduct: 現股當沖交易統計資訊／日報表
providerRule: TPEx states trade-date T values may be updated on T, T+1 and T+2 only after securities firms finish their overall processing and transmit final corrected amounts; T+2 is final.
frozenClockRules: Calendar date rollover from T to T+1 does not prove the T+1 provider update has occurred.
A T+1 early-morning readback identical to T_PRELIM is a stability observation, not proof of zero T1 revision.

T1_REVISED labeling requires a defensible post-workflow T+1 capture; if exact provider completion time is unavailable, preserve capturedAt and bound firstKnownAt rather than invent a publication minute.
T2_FINAL may be labeled final only under the provider's explicit T+2 finality rule and the preserved trade date.
Later vintages are append-only and never overwrite earlier first-known versions.
parserAuthorityRules: Canonical table parsing controls row-count and row-level evidence.
Natural-language page summaries or extraction-layer estimated row counts are non-authoritative diagnostics.
Any summary/parser discrepancy must be resolved against the actual displayed table before a revision is declared.
exactNext: Later on 2026-10-06 re-capture the 2026-10-05 table after the T+1 reporting workflow is plausibly complete; apply the frozen union/common-support revision contract and only then record the T1 revised vintage.
